yourPersonalAndSharedNotesAndDatabasesPa: Your personal and shared notes and databases, page tree, trash, version history, reminder lists with nested reminders and tags, personal files and folders, covers, uploaded images and GIFs, formatting, widget settings, favorites, locks, your external 2FA service keys, and expense history – all in one encrypted file.
whenImportingFromAPreviousArchiveAllNote: When importing from a previous archive, all notes and available reminder lists will be converted into personal copies, without participants or access rights. The original data will be preserved for all participants. The main list from the new archive will also be added as a separate personal copy. Reminders from the old archive will be moved to your 'Reminders'. Links to notes with temporary access will also be transferred without the old link's access period. Spaces, contacts, conversations, comments from others, account password, your own 2FA, password hint, sessions, and publications will not be transferred. To transfer external service keys, your account's 2FA must be enabled.
widgetsWithTheSelectedReminderListWhichH: Widgets with the selected reminder list, which has been deleted or is no longer accessible, will not be included in the export settings. Your current main page will be preserved during export.
archiveLimitIsSetByTheServerImporting: Archive limit is set by the server. Importing adds copies: existing notes and files are preserved. A second import will create another copy. The volume of imported data is limited by your account quota.
transferPagesDatabasesAndNestedFilesFrom: Transfer pages, databases, and nested files from a Notion ZIP export.
transferDocumentsAndCollectionsFromAMark: Transfer documents and collections from a Markdown ZIP export, along with images, audio, and other attachments.
theFileContainsYourPersonalDataAsWell: The file contains your personal data, as well as your shared notes and reminder lists. The archive also contains the secret keys of your external 2FA services, if they have been added. Set a separate password and save it: you will need it when importing.
personalArchiveDownloadedSaveThePassword: Personal archive downloaded. Save the password separately.
firstWeWillCheckTheFileAndShow: First, we will check the file and show its contents. The data will be added to your current account.
whenSelectingTheMainPageSettingTheSettin: When selecting the main page setting, the settings from the archive will be replaced. Account protection and access to shared workspaces will be preserved.

settingsForModulesLayoutAndWidgetsFromTh: Settings for modules, layout, and widgets from the archive will be applied.
transferringNotesDatabasesAndAttachments: Transferring notes, databases, and attachments. This may take several minutes…
connectionInterruptedCheckTheNotesSectio: Connection interrupted. Check the notes section before re-importing.

ofWhichAreSavedOnOurSide: Of which are saved on our side
theseImagesRemainAsExternalLinksAndMay: These images remain as external links and may not open.
pagesDatabasesAndFilesWillBeAddedTo: Pages, databases, and files will be added to your personal notes with the original nesting. Existing notes will be preserved. {{value0}}
inOutlineSelectTheExportOfTheCollection: In Outline, select the export of the collection or document in Markdown along with attachments. Select one or more ZIP files: documents, nested pages, images, and files will be added to your personal notes.
inNotionSelectHtmlOrMarkdownCsvExport: In Notion, select HTML or Markdown & CSV export, all content and subfolder structure. HTML better preserves formatting and database property types. Download the resulting ZIP file completely. If the export consists of parts or you have two formats, select them together: identical pages will be merged by Notion ID, and the formatting will be taken from HTML.
outlineParticipantsAccessRightsAndHistor: Outline participants, access rights, and history are not transferred.
notionParticipantsAccessRightsVersionHis: Notion participants, access rights, version history, formulas, and view settings are not included in the export; databases will open with saved values.
selectNoMoreThan20ZipFiles: Select no more than 20 ZIP files.
theZipFileShouldNotExceed512Mb: The ZIP file should not exceed 512 MB.
newPersonalPagesWillBeCreatedReUploading: New personal pages will be created. Re-uploading the same export will add another copy.
readyToAddNotes: Validation complete. Ready to add pages.

notionSyncIntro: Choose a page to sync changes from its entire subtree.
notionReadOnlyHint: Edit the original in Notion. A new private copy appears here; existing notes are preserved.
notionServerSetup: This connection is optional. An administrator can configure Notion OAuth on the server. ZIP import works without it.
notionSubtreeHint: Includes nested pages and new subpages added later.
notionConsentHint: Each account grants access in Notion. The default connection only reads selected pages.
notionConnectionInvalid: Unable to open the Notion connection.
notionDisconnectConfirm: Disconnect sync? All copied pages and files will be preserved and become editable.
notionExperimentalHelp: Writing requires the checkbox for this tree. Supports text, lists, checkmarks, adding and removing plain paragraphs, text columns and their widths. Restructuring columns containing attachments or shared blocks is not supported yet; pages, databases and attachments are never deleted.
notionExperimentalConfirm: Enable two-way sync for this subtree? DrG changes will be sent to Notion using the current connection. This is experimental; start with test pages.
notionWriteSetup: Connect Notion with read, update and insert content capabilities. Two-way sync is enabled separately for each subtree.
notionRecoveryIntro: Choose a page and which version to replace. Other pages are not replaced, and the selected sync mode is preserved.
notionRecoveryKeepCopy: Save the replaced version as a separate note
notionRecoveryCopyHint: The copy will appear in your private DrG notes. Uncheck to replace without creating a separate note.
notionRecoveryDone: The selected page has been recovered. The sync mode is unchanged; any other failures must be resolved separately.
notionConflictIntro: Automatic writes are stopped. Accept the current Notion version and preserve yours as an independent copy, or keep this copy in DrG and disconnect.
notionAcceptSource: Accept Notion and keep my copy
notionConflictKept: Both versions are preserved. The link now only syncs from Notion to DrG.
notionImportVisibility: Completed pages are already visible in Notes. The remaining pages will appear as they finish loading.
notionPagesEmpty: No pages found. Check the connection’s page access in Notion.
notionSyncStopped: Synchronization is stopped. Your changes are retained in DrG.
notionUnsavedKept: Unsaved text is retained on this device. Manage the connection or create an independent copy.
notionReviewCached: Showing the last saved Notion version. Loading the current version before you choose.
notionReviewResolved: The content already matches Notion. Synchronization has resumed; you can close this comparison.
notionTreeHint: Pages follow this Notion connection’s access. If a newly shared page is missing, refresh the list or paste its link.
notionTreeReserved: Already present in “{{title}}”; the link is retained
notionAssetBlocked: Automatic retries stopped after five failures. Retry the download or change the source in Notion.
notionAssetRetrying: The download will be retried automatically with increasing intervals.
